verdict.rationale: ADK ships a code-first, well-documented programmatic API (Agent/Tool classes, workflow constructs) plus a documented CLI (adk run/web/eval/deploy) across Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and Kotlin, with concrete code samples and CLI usage examples in both docs and GitHub. Missing for 10: a formal generated API reference or OpenAPI-style spec (probes show no openapi.json/llms.txt) and independent third-party corroboration beyond first-party docs.
